releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.1 - Exact Voucher Tabs + Readable Metrics
releaseNotes:
• 📊 VOUCHER TABS NOW EXACT: Using / Expired / Unused always add up to the total. Expired contains ONLY quota-finished or time-due vouchers — a live session is never in Expired (live + 10-min recently-online sticky protection). Partially-consumed vouchers with remaining data/time stay in Unused (sellable again).
• 🗑️ SAFE CLEANUP: 'Delete used' now removes ONLY provably finished vouchers and protects every live + recently-online customer (no accidental kicks).
• 🎨 READABILITY FIX: usage metrics & badge text no longer use dark-green-on-pale colors — theme-aware bright emerald/cyan in dark mode, deep green on light.
• 🧪 8 new unit tests proving quota-full/time-due/using-protection/exhaustiveness math.
• 🖥️ FEATURES.md + SETUP_GUIDE.md + portal_templates/README.md docs shipped.
• 🔒 v1.10.0 features preserved: Flow Control (32 services/8 groups), Live Topology, MikroPilot theme, 10 portal templates, exact V3 quota/time enforcement (CPU-safe).

Install over v1.10.0/v1.9.2 — same signature, no uninstall.
